chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding
a man who neglected the Sa'y deliberately. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Upon him is the Hajj from the future year.'

key_terms.السَّعْي: Sa'y (ritual walking between Safa and Marwa)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pilgrint intentionally skips Sa'y during Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that intentionally omitting Sa'y incurs the penalty of 'Hajj from the following year' (Hajj al-Mu'tadil), a ruling distinct from the minor penalty of a sacrificial animal applied to unintentional omissions. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the intentionality (ikhtiyar) of the omission in determining the severity of the compensation. The ruling underscores the integral status of Sa'y as a pillar (rukn) of Hajj in Shia fiqh, requiring full renewal of the ritual if missed deliberately.
